what: Threshold rules for the finder and sorter gates (work order TK-G1 follow-up). Committed BEFORE the null FLAG-rate run. A later change is a dated entry under 'amendments', never an edit.

gated_design.finder: gate_missing_column_finder.py: 40 studies x 15 rows, 3 noise columns, 1 planted label of 6 levels, seed 20261123
gated_design.sorter: gate_denominator_sorter.py: 20 studies x 10 rows, row sd 0.3, seed 20261123

finder.flag: flag <=> recovered share > the maximum of the 200-shuffle null at the gated design
finder.bias: recovered / realized share, reported per planted s; a report, not a threshold
finder.scope: the gated design only; another design needs its own 200-shuffle null

sorter.finding: finding <=> the field-drop outcome test fires

combined_claim: needs BOTH a finder flag AND a sorter outcome test that fires

null_flag_rate_run.what: the finder's own FLAG (its 499 inner shuffles, MIN_EXCESS 0.02, unchanged) on the planted grouping, with the planted labels shuffled across rows
null_flag_rate_run.rule: if the FLAG rate at any planted s is above 0.05: report it and set no threshold
null_flag_rate_run.also_reported: the rate under the declared rule above (share > max of the 200-shuffle null), by leave-one-out over the same 200 shuffles

null_max.how: the largest of the six 200-shuffle null maxima already recorded at the gated design, read by script from samples/gate_missing_column_finder.sample.txt and samples/null_flag_rate_finder.sample.txt

power_floor_sweep.above: a replicate counts when its recovered within-study share for the planted grouping is above null_max
power_floor_sweep.floor: the smallest planted s at which at least 19 of 20 replicates are above null_max; if no s in the sweep reaches 19, the floor reads 'above 0.07, below 0.1' or NOT REACHED as the counts show
power_floor_sweep.reported_per_s: recovered mean and min, count above null_max, bias = recovered / realized
power_floor_sweep.no_change: no threshold is changed after the run
